findings.label: Eager synchronous rebuild cost
findings.detail: RefreshSlideSections re-resolves and regenerates all song slides and reloads all background bitmaps synchronously on the UI thread on every refresh, including each ZoomSlider_ValueChanged tick. Accepted by the task for a handful of items (same per-slide cost as the proven single-item path), but could stutter on a large, image-heavy service. Consider debouncing zoom-driven rebuilds or caching generated slides per item if services grow; the _sectionByItem map is the designated hook.

findings.label: Live-highlight index assumption
findings.detail: UpdateLiveSectionHighlights walks the live section's WrapPanel by child index and treats child i as slide i. Safe as written because a populated section's WrapPanel contains only Border thumbnails (the 'could not load' TextBlock only appears when there are zero slides, i.e. no Borders), but the invariant is implicit rather than enforced. Keep in mind if non-thumbnail children are ever added to a populated section.
